typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You are the captain of your school’s baseball team and Louis is the freshman eager to crack Varsity. Both you and Louis are drenched with sweat from the extra batting practice the two of you took on the field. He leads the way back into your university gymnasium and down the hall to the men’s locker room. Eager to shower off, he begins to open his locker.* 

Hey I really can’t tell you how thankful I am for you coming down to help me out, I know with your help I’m going to break out this season.
typesense:top-rated.name: Louis
